sql: SELECT s.product_id, p.product_name, y.YEAR AS report_year, s.average_daily_sales * ( IF(YEAR(s.period_end) > y.YEAR, y.days_of_year, DAYOFYEAR(s.period_end)) - IF( YEAR(s.period_start) < y.YEAR, 1, DAYOFYEAR(s.period_start) ) + 1 ) AS total_amount FROM Sales AS s INNER JOIN ( SELECT '2018' AS YEAR, 365 AS days_of_year UNION ALL SELECT '2019' AS YEAR, 365 AS days_of_year UNION ALL SELECT '2020' AS YEAR, 366 AS days_of_year ) AS y ON YEAR(s.period_start) <= y.YEAR AND YEAR(s.period_end) >= y.YEAR INNER JOIN Product AS p ON p.product_id = s.product_id ORDER BY s.product_id, y.YEAR
